blocks.text: Vector zarb ki do qismein hain; un ke products scalar product aur vector product kehlate hain.

blocks.title: Scalar aur vector products
blocks.text: Agar do vectors ka product scalar quantity de to use scalar product kehte hain, jabke agar do vectors ka product vector quantity de to use vector product kehte hain.

Do vectors A aur B ka scalar product A.B likha jata hai aur A.B = A B cos theta ... (2.6) se bayan hota hai, jahan A aur B vectors ki miqdarein aur theta un ke darmiyan zawiya hai. Physical matlab ke liye dono vectors pehle ek asal (origin) par laye jate hain (Fig. 2.2a); phir A.B = A (A par B ka projection), ya A.B = A (A ki simt mein B ke component ki miqdar) = A (B cos theta) = AB cos theta (Fig. 2.2b). Isi tarah B.A = B (A cos theta) = BA cos theta.

Yeh product tab samne aata hai jab hum aisi force F ka kiya kaam dekhte hain jis ka point of application F ki line of action se zawiya theta banati simt mein faasla d chalta hai (Fig. 2.3): kiya gaya kaam = (harkat ki simt mein force ka muassir component) x chala faasla = (F cos theta) d = F d cos theta; vector notation mein F.d = F d cos theta = kiya gaya kaam.

items: Chunke A.B = AB cos theta aur B.A = BA cos theta = AB cos theta, A.B = B.A: zarb ki tarteeb ghair-mutalliq hai, scalar product commutative hai.
Do ek doosre par amood vectors (theta = 90 degrees) ka scalar product sifr hai: A.B = AB cos 90 = 0.

Do mutawazi vectors ka scalar product un ki miqdaron ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai: mutawazi vectors (theta = 0) ke liye A.B = AB cos 0 = AB; ulte mutawazi (antiparallel, theta = 180 degrees) ke liye A.B = AB cos 180 = -AB. Vector ka khud se product us ki miqdar ke muraba ke barabar hai: A.A = AA cos 0 = A^2.

Rectangular components mein A.B = Ax Bx + Ay By + Az Bz ... (2.7). Equation (2.6) phir do vectors ke darmiyan zawiya deti hai: chunke A.B = AB cos theta = Ax Bx + Ay By + Az Bz, cos theta = (Ax Bx + Ay By + Az Bz) / (AB) ... (2.8).

blocks.text: Do vectors A aur B ka vector product ek vector hai jo A x B = AB sin theta n-hat ... (2.9) se bayan hota hai, jahan n-hat A aur B ki satah par amood unit vector hai (Fig. 2.4a). Us ki simt right-hand rule se milti hai: A aur B ki dumein (tails) sath rakh kar un ki satah tay karein; product vector ki simt is satah par amood hai; pehle vector A ko do mumkina zawiyon mein se chhote se B mein ghumayein aur daen haath ki ungliyan ghumao ki simt mein mor lein, angootha seedha rakhte hue; product vector ki simt seedhe angoothe ke saath hai (Fig. 2.4b). Is qaide ki wajah se B x A, A x B ke ulte nishan ka vector hai (Fig. 2.4c); is liye A x B = -B x A ... (2.10).

items: Chunke A x B, B x A jaisa nahi, cross product non-commutative hai: A x B, B x A ke barabar nahi.
Do amood vectors (theta = 90 degrees) ke cross product ki miqdar zyada se zyada hai: A x B = AB sin 90 n-hat = AB n-hat.
Do mutawazi vectors ka cross product null vector hai, kyunke aise vectors ke liye theta = 0 ya 180 degrees, to A x B = AB sin 0 n-hat = 0 ya AB sin 180 n-hat = 0; nateejatan A x A = 0.
A x B ki miqdar A aur B ko do mutasil kinaron ke taur par le kar bane parallelogram ke raqbe ke barabar hai (Fig. 2.4d).

Jab force F kisi sakht jism par aise nuqte par lagti hai jis ka position vector, us axis ke kisi nuqte se jis ke gird jism ghoomta hai, r ho, to force ka ghumane wala asar, torque tau, r aur F ke vector product se milta hai: tau = r x F.
Magnetic field B mein charge q aur velocity v wale zarre par force F, v aur B ke vector product se milti hai: F = q (v x B).

blocks.prompt: Do vectors ke cross aur scalar products ki miqdarein 4 sqrt(3) aur 4 hain. Un ke darmiyan zawiya nikalein (numerical problem 2.1). Yeh bhi batayein ke dot product kab zyada se zyada aur cross product kab zyada se zyada hota hai.
blocks.explanation: AB sin theta = 4 sqrt(3) aur AB cos theta = 4, to tan theta = sqrt(3) aur theta = 60 degrees. Dot product mutawazi vectors ke liye sab se zyada hai (cos theta = 1) aur cross product amood vectors ke liye (sin theta = 1).

items: Dot product: A.B = AB cos theta = A (A par B ka projection) = Ax Bx + Ay By + Az Bz; commutative; amood ke liye 0, mutawazi ke liye AB, khud ke liye A^2; kaam = F.d.

Cross product: A x B = AB sin theta n-hat, right-hand rule se satah par amood; A x B = -B x A; amood ke liye zyada se zyada, mutawazi ke liye null; miqdar = parallelogram ka raqba; torque r x F, force q (v x B).
